featured.rule:
### Event Rules for Participants  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots.  
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All Other TruckersMP Rules Apply.  

### Event Rules for Event Staff  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All Other **[TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules)** Apply.

## Welcome to the event!
### This November, Ponc Logistics X TurkishLine is hitting the road for a special ATS convoy, taking us from Elko Garage to Hilt Bitumen.
### Our journey will begin in the desert roads of Elko, surrounded by wide open landscapes and classic American highways. As we continue toward Hilt, drivers will experience a mix of long roads, scenic routes, and relaxing views across the western states.
### This convoy promises a calm yet enjoyable drive, bringing together our drivers for a memorable American Truck Simulator experience. Whether you are joining for the scenery, the road, or the community spirit, this route will offer a great time for everyone.

### Hello Truckers! 

![](https://s1.imgbb.ws/file/storage-sv1/86Qja.png)
![](https://s2.imgbb.ws/file/storage-sv2/86N4M.png)

![](https://s1.imgbb.ws/file/storage-sv1/86KF2.png)

Asia Real Operations hosted by Super Event returns in 2026, Yes, it’s the 3rd edition of Real Operations

Make sure you add the date into your calendar so you do not miss the long-awaited event! We are very happy to confirm that the event will take place on November 28, 2026 from 12:30 - 14:00 (UTC), We will depart from **Salzburg + Bratislava + Dresen**, come on join us enjoy this event!

As this event is one of our biggest of the year, everything will happen in real time, ready for you, truckers, to be witnessed! Emergency vehicles, police chases, and more!

To make the experience more immersive, you might see an operation happen right in front of you during the event.

## Event Rules for Participants:
* The Event Staff are recognized as: "AROV3 | Staff" “AROV3 | Real Ops" "AROV3 | Lead" ”AROV3 | Tail" "AROV3 | GMs" "AROV3 | Media"or similar.

upcoming.rule:
### **Event Rules - For Participants**
* Event Staff are identified by the tag “Elite | Staff” or a similar designation.
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* Impersonating Event Staff by using the tags listed above is prohibited.
* With the exception of Event Staff, all participants must use only BUSES. All other vehicle types—such as tow trucks, trucks, passenger cars, etc.—are prohibited.
* Participants experiencing consistent lag must remain at the very back of the convoy.
* Advertising on the server is prohibited (except for Event Staff).
* Overtaking is prohibited during the convoy.
* Participants must follow the instructions of Event Staff.
* Participants must park in their assigned spaces. If you do not have an assigned space, you must park in the “Public Parking” area.
* Participants must depart from the starting point only when instructed to do so and in an orderly manner (one at a time).
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.


### **⭐ Event Rules - For Event Staff**
* No more than 2 members of the event staff may overtake the convoy at the same time.
* Event staff may drive in the opposite direction only on roads separated by a median or barrier (in accordance with the overtaking rule above).
* Event Staff may block intersections and roads leading to intersections to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff may park outside the boundaries (out of bounds). However, this must be at ground level; parking on top of buildings or in locations deemed inappropriate by  TruckersMP Admin is not permitted.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.
